concept.title: Accessible product operation
concept.shortdesc: Use BPM with localized status, error, focus, keyboard feedback, and responsive layouts.

section.title: Keyboard
section.p: Keyboard behavior must keep primary actions, navigation, filters, editor controls, confirmations, and links reachable without a pointer.

section.title: Focus
section.p: Focus indicators show where the next action applies after navigation, mode switching, validation, and dialogs.

section.title: Status feedback
section.p: Localized status and error feedback explain save, validation, import, export, archive, restore, and deletion outcomes.

section.title: Responsive layouts
section.p: Responsive layouts preserve the same tasks on narrow screens; theme and locale changes must not hide warnings or destructive confirmations.
